header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Unanimously Accept Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) as Khalifah

blocks.text: The Narration of Hadhrat Ibn Seereen Concerning what Happened in the Hall of the Banu Saa'idah

Hadhrat Ibn Seereen (RAH) narrates from a man from the Banu Zurayq tribe that on that fateful day (when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away), Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) went to the Ansaar. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "O assembly of Ansaar! We certainly do not deny the rights owed to you. In fact, no Mu'min can deny these rights. By Allaah! You have always shared in any good that came to us. However, the Arabs will never accept and shall never be happy with any leader that does not belong to the Quraysh. This is because from all Arabs the Quraysh are the most eloquent of people, have the best lineage, have the best city and feed the most people. So come to Umar and pledge your allegiance to him." "No!" replied the Ansaar. "Why not?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). The Ansaar replied, "Because we fear that he will give others preference over us." Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Never! I shall never do this as long as I live. Rather pledge your allegiance to Abu Bakr (RA)." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said to Hadhrat Umar (RA), "You are stronger than me." "But you are more virtuous than me," responded Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) repeated this three times. On the third time, Hadhrat Umar (RA) added, "Together with your virtue, you shall have my strength with you." Addressing the people, he then said, "Pledge your allegiance to Abu Bakr (RA)." As people were pledging their allegiance to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), some people approached Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) (to pledge allegiance to him). Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) said to them, "How can you come to me when you have amongst you 'the second of the two'?" [^1]
The Sahabah (RA) Place Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Ahead for Khilaafah, Are Pleased to Select him and Condemn Anyone who desires to Divide their Unity
A narration of Ibn Asaakir and the Statement of Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) Concerning the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Muslim narrates that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) sent a message to Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) saying, "Come forward so that I may make you the Khalifah because I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say that every nation has an Ameen (someone most trustworthy) and that you are the Ameen of this Ummah." Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) replied, "I can never step ahead of a person (yourself) whom Rasulullaah ﷺ had instructed to lead us in salaah." [^2]
Ibn Abi Shayba, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.3 Pg.140).
